tasks.title: R20: a client retry never pays twice for one request
tasks.description: A client times out before /settle answers and retries. R20a (server): a retry of the same request carrying a fresh payment and the same client idempotency key (payment-identifier id, or Idempotency-Key when the server documents it) is not charged again; the server returns the earlier result or settlement reference, and the facilitator double sees at most one successful /settle for the request. R20b (client): a retry that reuses the same signed payment (same nonce or transaction) is refused as a duplicate by /settle and the original result is returned; the bundled client harness flags a client that re-signs a fresh payment for the same request without an idempotency key. Control: a stock @x402/express server with a durable idempotency record and the stock @x402/fetch client. Faulty builds: a server that settles both payments (settle_both), one that keys the record by payment instead of request (key_by_payment), and a client that re-signs on timeout (resign_on_timeout). Solana devnet and Base Sepolia, facilitator double on loopback, as R14. Probe flag --retry and Action input retry. A corpus case records the scenario as reported publicly.
